name: Friendship ended
meaning: A man poses with his new best friend, photos of the old friend crossed out, under rainbow text. For dramatically replacing one thing with another.
when_to_use: left = the old thing being dropped (covers the old name after "Friendship ended with", top right). right = the new favorite (covers the new name after "Now"). The swap is the joke.
baked_in_text: The image already reads "Friendship ended with MUDASIR" across the top and "Now SALMAN is my best friend" down the middle. The left and right captions overlay the two names; only supply the replacement names.
